metadata.description: Apta team agent skills, installable as plugins for Claude Code and Codex / ChatGPT desktop.

plugins.name: apta-superskill
plugins.description: Apta's office frontend standard for React + TypeScript apps built with Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Zustand and an Axios service layer.

plugins.name: apta-go-backend
plugins.description: Scaffold an Apta-standard Go + Gin backend modeled on fleet-backend, and add CRUD endpoints to it.

plugins.name: apta-go-local-cloud
plugins.description: Scaffold an Apta Go + Gin backend split into shared, local and cloud modules joined by go.work, and add CRUD endpoints that respect which side owns the data.

plugins.name: apta-flutter-desktop
plugins.description: Standard for building Apta Flutter Desktop apps (Linux & Windows).

plugins.name: apta-frontend-deployment-setup
plugins.description: Set up Docker + docker compose + GitHub Actions deployment for a Vite/React frontend, following the Apta pattern.

plugins.name: apta-investigate
plugins.description: Investigate a reported issue in an Apta project by checking its code against an Environment's PostgreSQL database and Grafana Loki logs, read-only.

plugins.name: grill-then-plan
plugins.description: Run a grill-with-docs interview, then write an indexed implementation plan with numbered steps and acceptance checks.
